name: Ballinkillen
bedsNote: 2 of the 4 bedrooms are on the ground floor, incl. the en-suite main bedroom
heating: Oil-fired central heating, plus a solid-fuel stove
tagline: A four-bed detached house on about 1.5 acres in the Barrow valley, a kilometre from Ballinkillen's school and church and 6 km from Bagenalstown station.

pros.detail: Main bedroom (4.44 × 4.17 m) with en-suite shower and bath, plus Bedroom 1 (3.84 × 3.77 m), both downstairs. Ready-made for the parents.
Room for the vizslas, plus a stone outhouse and three sheds.
Ballinkillen NS, 990 m, about 126 pupils; Borris NS (198) is 5.3 km.
Mid-range of the 140–280 m² target, with a floored attic store on top.

pros.text: BER C, better than most rural stock
pros.detail: 188 kWh/m²/yr; oil central heating plus a stove.
Muine Bheag (Bagenalstown) station: about 7 Dublin trains a weekday, roughly 1h15–1h25 to Heuston.
Borris College, a mixed ETB school of 558 pupils with over 80% going to third level in 2016; Presentation/De La Salle in Bagenalstown (769, mixed) is the other choice.

cons.detail: Ballinkillen has a school, church and GAA pitch; no trading shop could be confirmed. Anything else means a 5–7 km drive to Borris or Bagenalstown.
St Luke's, Kilkenny is about 22 km as the crow flies; Wexford General and UH Waterford are 45+ km.
Bagenalstown is on the Waterford line, so there's no frequent commuter service; Carlow (about 10 a day) is 20 km north.
A heat-pump swap is a rough €15–25k before SEAI grants.
Ask for water test results and the septic tank's age and compliance.

ai.why: Two ground-floor bedrooms on 1.5 acres under €500k, school nearby. Tiny village, few trains.

internet.detail: NBI fibre likely. Ballinkillen was named in NBI's 2020 south Carlow survey, and the Borris deployment area (800 premises) opened for pre-orders in March 2023. Confirm on nbi.ie with R21 AD77.
